pkgmetadata.longdescription: On-device hybrid search engine for markdown files, meeting notes, and knowledge bases, combining BM25 full-text search, vector similarity search, and LLM reranking. Ships as a Node.js CLI with vendored prebuilt native dependencies (better-sqlite3, sqlite-vec, four tree-sitter grammars, and node-llama-cpp's CPU backend); vector embedding and reranking models are downloaded on first use.
